payload.goal: Optimization technique for NVIDIA Blackwell (SM100): Hopper: CUDA Core Promotion (Nc=128)

problem.statement: Fine-Grained FP8/FP4 Quantization -- Hopper: CUDA Core Promotion (Nc=128)

payload.what: On Hopper (SM90), the wgmma instruction accumulates in Tensor Core registers with limited precision (~FP22, not true FP32). To maintain numerical accuracy, DeepGEMM promotes the partial sum to a separate FP32 accumulator on CUDA Cores every 4 wgmma instructions (Nc=128, since each wgmma processes 32 K-elements):
